item.title: Nylander's OT goal gives Leafs 4-3 victory, snaps Avalanche's 17-game home win streak
item.description: DENVER (AP) — William Nylander scored 3:59 into overtime and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat Colorado 4-3 on Monday night to snap the Avalanche’s 17-game home win streak . Nylander took a pass from Oliver Ekman-Larsson and lined it past Trent Miner.

item.title: Kraken rally from 2 goals down and beat Rangers 4-2
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Shane Wright scored the tiebreaking goal in the third period, and the Seattle Kraken rallied from two goals down and beat the New York Rangers 4-2 on Monday night.

item.title: Iranians able to make some calls abroad while internet access is still out after protests
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — Mobile phones in Iran were able to call abroad Tuesday after a crackdown on nationwide protests in which the internet and international calls were cut.
